page.layout: One scan showing the closed book from the fore-edge: a narrow strip of page edges between the boards, with marbled or speckled edge staining. No printed text is visible on this image.
page.notes: The scan shows the fore-edge of a closed book (page edges, spine-side cover boards and leather turn-ins), not a printed page. The edges are speckled in purple-brown. No text, running head, page number or signature is legible. A few stains and worn patches are visible along the leaves, but no printed words.
